articles.summary: So, the Ruby world has a nifty thinger for syncing up databases over the interwebs. It’s called Taps, from the superheroes over at Heroku. It’s great — you just run a little Sinatra-based server and then give the database URLs and it handles all of the plumbing. But, you see, I was none-too-keen on having […]
articles.title: Using taps without running a taps server
